payload.description_html: Compilation of Triassic ichthyosaurs with longirostrine skull morphology, all taxa to scale. (A) Utatsusaurus hataii (UHR 30691); (B) Grippia longirostris (PMU R445); (C) Mixosaurus cornalianus (BES SC 1000); (D) Besanosaurus leptorhynchus (PIMUZ T 4847); (E) Cymbospondylus buchseri (PIMUZ T 4351). Scale bar represents 10 cm.[1]
